// # THIS FILE IS AUTO GENERATED BY THE PROJECT IN "../codegen" (see repository!)
//! Module for letters with the font weight %FONT_WEIGHT% and size %FONT_SIZE%.
//!
//! The glyphs of each unicode range are stored in one binary blob in
//! `res_rasterized_characters/`. Each blob holds all glyphs of its unicode
//! range back to back, in ascending code point order (ignored code points are
//! skipped). Each glyph is exactly [`GLYPH_LEN`] bytes: [`RASTER_HEIGHT`] rows
//! of [`RASTER_WIDTH`] bytes each (row-major, top row first). Each byte is the
//! intensity (coverage) of one pixel from 0 to 255.
//!
//! # Font License
//! * Downloaded from: <https://fonts.google.com/noto/specimen/Noto+Sans+Mono>
//! * License: SIL Open Font License (OFL) <https://scripts.sil.org/cms/scripts/page.php?site_id=nrsi&id=OFL>

/// The constant height of each rasterized character for the given font weight
/// and size. This size corresponds to the size of the module name. It is the
/// line height of the font (ascender and descender), so the font size is about
/// 73% of this.
pub const RASTER_HEIGHT: usize = %CODEGEN_RASTER_HEIGHT%;

/// The constant width of each rasterized character for the given font weight and
/// size. This is less than [`RASTER_HEIGHT`], so that multiple letters can be print
/// next to each other and look "nice" out-of-the-box, hence, library users do not
/// have to perform additional alignment of characters or fill in padding.
pub const RASTER_WIDTH: usize = %CODEGEN_RASTER_WIDTH%;

/// The number of bytes of each glyph: [`RASTER_WIDTH`] * [`RASTER_HEIGHT`].
#[allow(dead_code)]
const GLYPH_LEN: usize = RASTER_WIDTH * RASTER_HEIGHT;
